_note: Hand-built catalog, refreshed 2026-11-23. Show, theater and runtime come from Broadway Direct's what's-on guide (plus Ticketmaster's November list for closing notes). Ages, content warnings, prices and review summaries are editorial estimates: confirm each on the official seller before relying on it. Only some shows have a real from-price (see price_basis). Inter Alia added 2026-11-27 (in previews at the Music Box; official site from its TDF listing, schedule from Broadway Direct). Official links (official_url) checked 2026-11-20 against each show's TDF listing or its own site (Other Desert Cities and Paranormal Activity supplied by Ciara). School Girls removed 2026-11-20 after it closed Nov 15. The Imaginary Invalid removed 2026-11-23 after it closed Nov 22. Added 2026-11-23 from TDF Show Finder: Galileo, Blue Man Group: A New Holiday Surprise, It's a Wonderful Life: A Live Radio Play, Now You See Me Live (official links as listed on TDF). Weekly schedule (24h times) is the regular week of Nov 16-22, 2026 from BroadwayWorld's 'Broadway This Week' grid (not overwritten on 2026-11-23 because Thanksgiving week is a holiday week); shows added Nov 23 use Broadway.com's listing for Nov 30-Dec 6 (Galileo: Broadway Direct's regular schedule). Holiday weeks differ. 'closes' = announced final performance (TDF/IBDB, checked 2026-11-20; & Juliet and Buena Vista Social Club closing dates added 2026-11-23 from Broadway Direct and Playbill); null = open run. 'about' is a 1-2 sentence summary in our own words from each show's official site, TDF or press coverage. 'deals' lists only time-limited sales confirmed from a source, each with an end date ('ends', inclusive); the apps hide a deal after it ends and the Monday task removes expired ones. Rush and lottery stay in 'rush_or_lottery'. 'opened' is the official opening night for recent shows.
